India successfully landed its Chandrayaan-3 mission near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, making it the first country to achieve this feat. [1] Celebrations erupted across India following the successful landing, with people cheering, dancing, sharing sweets, and waving national flags. [2] [3] [1] Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared that "India is now on the Moon" and announced that August 23 would be celebrated as National Space Day. [4] [5] [1] However, some images circulating online, purportedly showing celebrations for Chandrayaan-3, have been identified as being from the 2014 Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) success. [6]
